visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a wide shot of a massive, traditional bamboo swing structure, towering over 10 meters high, adorned with red lanterns and colorful triangular flags fluttering in the breeze. The structure is set against a clear blue sky, with a traditional Chinese temple's ornate roof and a modern residential building in the background. (2) A middle-aged man with a distinctive short ponytail, wearing a black graphic t-shirt, speaks directly to the camera in an outdoor urban setting. He gestures with his hands while variety-style text overlays appear around him. The lighting is bright and natural, indicating mid-day. (3) The man, now wearing a bright red-orange jumpsuit, is positioned on the high bamboo swing. The camera switches between low-angle shots looking up at the towering structure and high-angle POV-style shots looking down at the ground. He holds onto thick ropes and swings rhythmically. A small group of people, including some in uniforms, watch from the ground. (4) The man returns to a ground-level interview format, wearing his black t-shirt again. He talks to someone off-camera, looking slightly exhausted but satisfied. The background shows a street with traffic cones and parked scooters under the afternoon sun.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with an energetic, up-tempo rock track featuring heavy distorted electric guitars and driving electronic drums. A male speaker introduces the scene with high-pitched, enthusiastic energy, his voice projecting clearly over the background music. (2) A sharp 'thud' SFX triggers a transition as the male speaker reacts to a visual element. Background cheering and laughter from a small group are audible, adding to the festive atmosphere. The music continues with a consistent, fast BPM. (3) The speaker's voice shows signs of physical strain and high arousal as he shouts 'Tai-shuang-le!' (Too cool!), accompanied by a 'whoosh' sound effect that mimics the swing's motion. The music reaches a peak intensity with synth-driven swells. (4) The track concludes with the male speaker lowering his intensity to a conversational level, though his tone remains upbeat and friendly. A final bell-like 'ding' SFX punctuates the end of the narrative segment while the music fades out quickly.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to showcase a traditional cultural event in Chiayi, Taiwan—the high swing festival—through the first-person experience of a popular internet personality. It combines information about the 300-year history of the event with comedic and high-energy footage of the host participating in the challenging activity to engage a social media audience.
